'''Primus Goluud''' was a [[Red supergiant/Legends|red supergiant]] in the [[Goluud Corridor]], orbited by the [[Primus Goluud system]]. There were at least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]].

Shortly after the end of the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]], one of [[Ssk Kahorr]]'s drone ships crashed on Primus Goluud while using a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] created by [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]].

It was the location of the [[Battle at Primus Goluud]], where it was forced into a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] by a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] which destroyed the [[Star system/Legends|system]].
